description: A React component class for managing and displaying bot accounts within the Mattermost application, including loading bot data, rendering bot lists, and handling bot-related actions.

classes.name: Bots
classes.description: A React component for managing bot accounts, including loading, displaying, and enabling/disabling bots.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with loading set to true.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads bot data and fetches app bot IDs if enabled after component mounts.

methods.name: DisabledSection
methods.description: Renders a section for disabled bots if any are present.

methods.name: EnabledSection
methods.description: Renders a section for enabled bots.

methods.name: botToJSX
methods.description: Converts a bot object into a JSX element for rendering.

methods.name: bots
methods.description: Filters and sorts bots, returning JSX elements for enabled and disabled bots.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main bot management list UI.
